items.description: 🧠 BrainRooms – Brainrot BackroomsThe internet has lost its mind. And you're trapped inside.A grotesque nightmare. An unforgettable trash trip.A horror that doesn’t ask for permission.Enter a mental maze where every room is a rotten meme, every corridor an anxiety attack, and every entity a nightmare laughing at you.BRAINROOMS is a one-of-a-kind horror experience: a mix of fear, absurdity, cultural trash, and disturbing brilliance.A game that makes you scream… and then laugh at how hard you're screaming.🏚️ UNFORGETTABLE ENVIRONMENTS (EVEN IF YOU WISH YOU COULD FORGET THEM)💀 "It's not just jumpscares. It's a visual mindfuck."You’ll face classic horror settings… rewritten in even more twisted, creative, and disturbing ways.Faded poolrooms, soaked in a murderous silence.Endless backrooms, dripping with oppressive déjà vu.Brainrot-rooms, never-before-seen scenarios spawned from a feverish internet.Every room is a visual trap. Every environment has something off, unsettling… and insanely fascinating.👹 ENTITIES THAT STARE AT YOU. AND LAUGH.🔪 "Every entity has a face. And it's laughing at you."Forget the usual monsters. Here you’ll find:Deformed, grotesque, disturbing living memesOriginal nightmare-fuel creaturesBrainrot icons reimagined as horror abominationsThey all want you dead. But first, they want to break your mind.Chased by things you can’t understand, you’ll realize the real horror… is how much fun you're having.🕹️ ANXIOUS, FUN, AND SECRET-FILLED GAMEPLAYThe core is simple:Survive. Explore. Find the brainrot objects. Discover the truth.But every step is a risk. Every item a possible mistake. Every corner a lurking threat.Dynamic, unpredictable jumpscaresMysterious and creepy collectiblesCryptic notes telling a disturbing pastSecret events that change everythingIt’s not just horror.It’s anxiety with a grin. Fear with style.🔓 FREE MODE & INFINITE REPLAYABILITYOnce the story ends… the chaos truly begins.Unlock exploration mode and:Revisit every environment with no limitsTweak the rules: more monsters? More brainrot? All just a click awayDiscover every secret, every hidden glitchReplay to collect 100%… or just to lose your mind a little moreEvery run is different.Every return, more dangerous.🚨 WHY PLAY BRAINROOMS?Because no other game blends trash and terror like this.Because it’ll make you laugh, scream, and stay up at night.Because it’s an original, insane, inspired, one-of-a-kind project.Because internet horror has finally found its home.You’ve seen the backrooms. But you’ve never lived them like this.🧠 BRAINROOMS – BRAINROT BACKROOMSIt’s not just a game.It’s a mental experience you might not want to leave. items.description: Ten for the Descent is a dark strategy game about assembling a team for a descent where the greatest danger isn't the monsters. It's the people you send down.Choose ten. Some won't come back.Recruit flawed heroes with hidden motives, fragile minds, and loyalties that pull against each other. Every one of them carries a risk you can see, and a secret you can't. Equip them, steady them at the campfire, then watch them break. Fear spreads. Trust falls apart. One wrong call can turn an expedition into betrayal, panic, or something worse.Go deeper after gold, relics, and forbidden truths, but every step down makes survival cost more. Push on for the greater reward, or pull back before it all comes apart?Death here isn't always the end. Bring the fallen back with their medallions, if you're willing to pay the price.Between descents, return to the Keeper's Hall to rebuild, adapt, and send the next team into the dark.Every descent is a gamble. Every choice decides who lives and who doesn't. In the end the question isn't how strong your team is.It's how long it can hold itself together. items.description: A terrible curse has spread to our fair city. A curse that if left unchecked, will threaten us all. The nights have grown long, and with it, hordes of evil creatures come with it. Werewolves, demons, skeletons, ghouls, and they all want just one thing. To feast on our flesh and take over our souls.But we will not stand for this! We will band together and root out this evil. Together we will unmask whoever is behind this, and put a stop to this menace.GameplayWolflord is a multiplayer online intrigue game, where you will be matched with other players and put in small groups, where it is vital to your survival that you eliminate the evildoers among you. Or, if luck will have it and you draw an evil card yourself, work with your secret team to take control of the game.Lies, deception, evaluation and careful speech is key components to the game of Wolflord.HeritageWolflord is a modern take on the classic Mafia/Werewolf game genre that have existed as party games since the 80s.CharityWe donate 10% of all game proceedings to the Colorado Wolf Sanctuary.
